questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Endeavour, Primeland Holdings Pty Ltd and/or the Thirsty Camel business at the Bottleshop Site are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Endeavour, Primeland Holdings Pty Ltd and/or Thirsty Camel.
